notes: Verified against catalog; BILD 1 confirmed in addition to BILD 3 and BILD 4. NOT ABET-accredited (heavy biology/chemistry/physics emphasis). Jointly developed by Bioengineering, CSE, and the School of Biological Sciences; students may apply through any of these departments — this is the BENG-administered version. Same GPA and C- letter-grade rules. Physics is lecture-only (no labs listed): PHYS 2A, 2B, 2C.

buckets.label: Physics
buckets.note: Lecture only; no companion labs listed for this major.

buckets.label: Biology
buckets.note: BILD 1 confirmed in first-year spring; BILD 3/4 in sophomore year.

buckets.label: Lower-division engineering / computing
buckets.note: CSE 11/12/21 are the CS programming and discrete-math foundation.

buckets.label: Upper-division bioengineering core
buckets.note: BENG 181/182/183 are the bioinformatics computation sequence; 187A-D and 188A/B are senior design.

buckets.label: Upper-division supporting courses (CSE / Biology / Math)
buckets.note: CSE 100/101 (data structures/algorithms); BICD 100 (genetics); BIMM 100 (molecular biology); BIMM 185 (bioinformatics lab); MATH 186 (probabilistic statistics, upper-division).

buckets.label: Technical electives
buckets.note: Two courses from the departmental approved list; must be pre-approved. BENG 196/199 may count; 197/198 do not. Exact department pre-approved list from 'TE List - BINF 1.17.2024.pdf' (be.ucsd.edu, BE28 program). Requirement = 8 units total, all with 'engineering' as primary component; courses must be upper-div (100-series) Jacobs School of Engineering courses not required for the major, taken for a letter grade. Two quarters of BENG/CENG/ECE/MAE/NANO 199 with the same faculty satisfy both TE units. BENG 196 (industrial internship) counts (4 units) with departmental approval; BENG 197 and BENG 198 do NOT count. ENG 100D+100L (TIES) yield 8 units when taken per the rule. List is curated/subject to change and requires Student Affairs pre-approval, so it is enumerated explicitly rather than as department ranges. Cross-listed equivalents noted: CENG 101A=MAE 101A, CENG 134=NANO 134, MAE 131A=SE 110A.
